rows.label: tlk43100341_02_msg0001
rows.name: Well, I heard this from my dad.

rows.label: tlk43100341_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Last year, Core Crystals shipped out
of Fons Maim's port were stolen by a
pair of Blades.

rows.label: tlk43100341_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Even the strong mercenaries were
beaten, and Dad was injured too.

rows.label: tlk43100341_02_msg0004
rows.name:
If you've got lots of Core Crystals,
they might attack you too. You should
get away fast.
